title: Open Targets driver/target evidence track pack (hg38)
context: Open Targets is a CC0-licensed platform aggregating drug target and disease association evidence including cancer driver gene evidence from multiple open sources. It is the primary source for the M0 pilot pack (pilot-006); this source-catalog entry records the per-source gate triage for the broader Open Targets dataset beyond the pilot, enabling future packs to draw on additional target evidence layers without repeating the license gate.
objective: Apply the licensegate-002 gate to the full Open Targets dataset, produce a committed PASS artifact, and deliver an Open Targets cancer target-evidence track pack on hg38 complementary to pilot-006.
acceptanceCriteria: Source is Open Targets Platform (CC0); licensegate-002 PASS artifact committed with permitsRedistribution: true and nonCommercial: false with cited clause/URL.
coordgate-003 PASS artifact committed for hg38; coordinate convention handled and recorded.
All three browser targets emitted and render-verified; Open Targets cancer-target features appear at expected loci on hg38 with evidence in outcomes/ds-opentargets-005.json.
Per-feature provenance records Open Targets target IDs, source release version, and CC0 license; provenance completeness score ≥ 90/100.
Pack carries not-medical-advice notice; hosted at a loadable URL; adoption evidence or blocker recorded.
resources: PLAN.md §7 (Open Targets source entry — Accept A)
output: output/packs/opentargets-cancer-hg38/ — track files, browser configs, gate artifacts, manifest, and outcomes/ds-opentargets-005.json.
